story.title: T-Mobile’s new plans include swappable subscription perks

facts.text: T-Mobile is launching new “T-Mix” plans that bundle wireless service with subscriptions to services like Netflix, Apple TV, YouTube Premium, Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, device promotions, and more, as reported earlier by Fierce Network.
However, T-Mobile notes that how often you can change your perks depends on the benefit that you choose.
“Some benefits let you switch any time, others hold your Picks for a quarter or longer,” T-Mobile says, adding that some services will charge if you switch them outside the change window.
EE is launching the ultimate unlimited data plans on the best mobile network in the UK as rated by independent testing experts RootMetrics, for the sixth year running.
Customers who want access to the UK’s biggest and fastest 4G network can sign up for unlimited smartphone plans start from just £64 per month.

4G Smart Plan give customers two Swappable benefits, so they can choose the perks that best suits them at the start of their plan and then swap them for any of the other available benefits as their needs change.

EE has received extensive independent recognition, including being named the UK's best network every year since 2015 at The Mobile Choice Awards, The Mobile News Awards, The Mobile Industry Awards and by RootMetrics®.

All business users will also enjoy great benefits like Upgrade Anytime and BT Sport, and 5G plans include Mobile Iron Threat Defence to help protect against security risks including device, network and app attacks.
Customers with an unlimited 5G Smart smartphone plan will be able to choose from the widest range of 5G smartphones available from any UK network, starting from £69 per month.
For more information on EE’s new unlimited plans, customers can visit ee.co.uk/unlimited
